[[Vanquisher|Vanquish]] the [[Holdings of Chokhin]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Clear the Holdings of Chokhin in [[Vabbi]] of all enemies in [[hard mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 10,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,500 [[Gold]]
* 750 [[Sunspear Promotion Points]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 150 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
